text:
olivia: Heads-up — after rolling RBAC changes to canary tenants were seeing a cluster of SCIM provisioner 403s. ~18% of creates failing with KMS decrypt errors. sample below.

ben: link to logs? any tenant pattern? :thinking_face:

olivia: tenant ids mostly in eu-west-1 and using Okta. pasted sanitized log snippet: 
```
2026-03-23T10:12:34Z scim-provisioner ERROR user=alice+okta@example.com err="kms:decrypt: unsupported_jwe_alg" details="jwe.header={"alg":"dir","enc":"A256GCM"}"
http 403 {"error":"decrypt_failed","key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/abcd-tenant"}
```

cheng: that header is JWE "dir" (direct symmetric key) + A256GCM content encryption. our envelope parser expects a wrapped CEK (alg=RSA-OAEP). With alg=dir the CEK is not encrypted — we need the shared symmetric key which we do NOT have.

oncall-bot: incident created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-jwe-dir-provisioning priority=P2assignee=oncall

kms-bot: key-activity: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/abcd-tenant last-rotate=3659989000 supported_algorithms=["RSA-OAEP","RSA-OAEP-256"]

ben: rotation doesn't match dir alg. likely IdP changed encryption profile. if Okta switched to "Encrypt SAML assertion (AES)" -> JWE direct, we can't decrypt.

security: mitigation checklist (short):
- pause RBAC canary writes to SCIM provisioner immediately (limit blast radius)
- stop logging full decrypted assertions on error; switch to masked assertion id + sha256
- enqueue all failed SCIM ops into a durable backfill queue for later replay
- notify affected tenant admins + open support cases with IdP (okta ticket created)

olivia: I paused the canary and toggled masked-logging in prod config. no PII in logs now. queued failures into backfill-s3. pinged CS to contact tenants.

cheng: remediation options: 
1) Ask tenants to switch Okta/Microsoft encryption profile to RSA-OAEP so we can use KMS to unwrap CEK (preferred).
2) If tenant cannot change, provide a documented proxy pattern: tenants upload a tenant-specific symmetric key into their KMS (customer-managed) and provide a wrapped-data-key flow we can integrate with (but this requires contractual work and key-access policy).
3) Build a compatibility shim that attempts to detect alg==dir and surfaces an explicit actionable error to CS/tenant rather than trying to guess — safer.

ben: short-term patch: add parser and metric change to stop assertion echo, classify error reasons (alg_mismatch vs kms_decrypt vs key_missing) and emit a tenant-level alert when alg != expected. i'll push a tiny parser guard and metric increment to canary branch.

security: add automated alerting: create metric scim.provision.decrypt_fail_by_reason with tag reason:alg_mismatch and hook pager when rate > 5% for > 5m. also update runbook to include JWE-dir explanation and tenant outreach template.

olivia: okta case #200123 opened, I'm attaching tenant config screenshots. CS is drafting tenant notices that explain why they need to change assertion encryption to RSA-OAEP.

cheng: unit tests: add fixtures for alg="dir"/enc="A256GCM" and ensure parser returns error string "jwe-direct-unsupported". also add e2e to verify masked logging on decrypt failures.

ben: will deploy canary parser guard in next 40m, mark RFC and follow up with postmortem doc.

olivia: thanks — keeping thread for incident notes and PM. :thumbsup:
